title: 401(k) Match Calculator
description: Compute employer 401(k) match dollars from your contribution % and the match formula.
howto: Enter the % of salary you contribute.
Enter the employer match rate % and the % of salary the match applies to.
Read the free employer money, your contribution, and the combined total.

faqs.q: What does '50% match on the first 6%' mean?
faqs.a: Enter 50 as the match rate and 6 as the cap. If you contribute at least 6%, the employer adds 3% of your salary.

faqs.q: Should I contribute beyond the cap?
faqs.a: Contributions beyond the cap earn no extra match in this formula, but they still grow your own savings. This tool does not give advice.
Often not. Many employers vest the match over a few years; leaving early can forfeit unvested match dollars.
